Therefore, we strive for our office and amenities to be designed with our patients’ health and well-being in mind. Situated in a suburban community that blends small-town charm with convenience, this location is accessible and easy to travel to. Our Clayton office stands out with it’s peaceful atmosphere, where patients feel supported and leave motivated to take care of their oral health with ease and comfort.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What orthodontic treatments are offered in Clayton, NC?

At our office we provide all the necessary treatments including traditional metal and ceramic braces, Invisalign® clear aligners, retainers for maintenance and more!

Can teens and adults get Invisalign® in Clayton?

Yes. We offer Invisalign® for both teens and looking for a great alternative to traditional braces.

How do I schedule a free orthodontic consultation in Clayton?

To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!

Does the Clayton office offer emergency orthodontic care?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Are braces available for children in Clayton, NC?

Braces are available for children, and early interceptive treatments are recommended to prevent future dental issues, typically starting around age 7.

Do you accept dental insurance or membership plans for orthodontics?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
